findings.title: Unsubscribe does not mute watched or tracked topics
findings.body: When the user is watching or tracking this topic, this branch changes the level to `regular`, not `muted`. Regular topics can still generate direct reply and mention notifications, so the email link's promise to stop notifications is not met for these users. Set the level to muted for this unsubscribe action.

findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when the user has no topic-user row
findings.body: `find_by` can return nil for a recipient who has never visited or otherwise created a `TopicUser` row for this topic; such users can still receive mention or reply notification emails. The following access to `tu.notification_level` then raises a `NoMethodError`, so the unsubscribe link fails for them. Create or update the row through `TopicUser.change` instead of assuming it exists.

findings.title: A GET unsubscribe link toggles state on every visit
findings.body: This action is exposed only as GET, but it mutates the user's notification setting, and the operation toggles between muted and regular. Reopening or refreshing the email link can therefore undo the unsubscribe and resume notifications. Make the operation idempotently set muted, and avoid changing notification state on a GET request.
